Product Features

  • Symmetrical aesthetic design: 180 x 40 x 50 cm symmetrical structure, natural wood color matched with black lines on the cabinet doors, it's like bringing the "geometric art in the forest" to the living room. With a 75-inch TV, visual balance and high-end are achieved.
  • 4 cabinets for plenty of storage space: Behind 4 cabinet doors are 4 independent storage areas where game consoles, routers and old magazines can be stored separately. When the cabinet doors are closed, only the wood grain and lines are visible, so that "the mess" remains hidden even in small apartments.
  • Stable and slim load capacity: 8 table legs distribute the pressure, the total load capacity is 30kg, and the load capacity of the shelf is 10kg. You can safely place TVs, stereos, and decorations. It does not deform even after prolonged use and firmly supports the center of gravity of the living room.
  • Natural wood texture: The original wood color has a warm texture that puts an end to the cold industrial feel, and is rounded off by black lines to outline the contours. The simplicity hides the excellence of the "designer style".
  • Refined details: The black lines on the cabinet door are not only decorative, they break the monotony of the solid color and give the symmetrical cabinet multi-layered elements.
  • 75 Inch Adjustment: The 180cm length is specially designed for 75 inch TVs, leaving space for table lamps and green plants on both sides, eliminating the crowding of the TV wall and making the viewing distance more reasonable.
  • Installation and maintenance: Made of chipboard, it is easy to install; the surface is wear-resistant and easy to clean, coffee stains and dust are easy to wipe off, and daily maintenance is effortless.
  • Room expansion: Symmetrical structure + open worktop visually stretches the length of the living room and makes a small room appear larger; the countertop can be used to place aromatherapy and photo frames, so the storage cabinet can also serve as a "display rack".
  • Functional addition: 4 cabinets meet the need for "hiding", and the open countertop allows "displaying". From storing small items to decorating the room, a TV cabinet meets the double requirements of "practicality + appearance" in the living room. With one set, you save N storage boxes!
  • Note: This product is delivered in two packages and may arrive with a time delay. Please make sure both packages have arrived before assembly.
